components.name: Primary Button

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Alternative action paired with a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: Tahoma, 'Segoe UI', Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; border-radius: 14px; padding: 0.95rem 1.4rem; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; background: #fff; color: var(--color-primary, #5a2d0c); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #a87b51 30%, white); transition: transform 0.2s ease, filter 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); filter: brightness(1.02); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5a2d0c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Checkout Button
components.description: Full-width copper gradient for 'Confirmar pedido', the site's strongest call to action.
components.css: .ds-btn-checkout { font-family: Tahoma, 'Segoe UI', Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; width: 100%; padding: 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 12px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #b97a56 0%, #8c5a3d 100%); color: #fff; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.2s ease, filter 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-checkout:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); filter: brightness(1.04); } .ds-btn-checkout:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #5a2d0c; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Checkout form field with a copper focus glow.
components.css: .ds-input { font-family: Tahoma, 'Segoe UI', Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; width: 100%; padding: 0.8rem; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #d8c8bc; background: #fffdfa; color: #5a2d0c; font-size: 1rem; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #b97a56; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(185, 122, 86, 0.14); background: #fff; }

components.name: Locked Field
components.description: Read-only field for fixed values such as City and Country.
components.css: .ds-input-locked { font-family: Tahoma, 'Segoe UI', Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; width: 100%; padding: 0.8rem; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid #d8c8bc; background: #f3ebe4; color: #6b5446; font-size: 1rem; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-input-locked:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Navbar link with a Toffee underline that grows on hover.

components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 2rem; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; background: linear-gradient(to top, #f5e6d3, #f8f4ef); font-family: Tahoma, 'Segoe UI', Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; color: #5a2d0c; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.1rem; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -4px; width: 0; height: 2px; background: #a87b51; transition: width 0.3s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible::after { width: 100%; } .ds-nav-active { color: #a87b51; }

components.css: .ds-card { font-family: Tahoma, 'Segoe UI', Geneva, Verdana, sans-serif; padding: 2rem; border-radius: 24px; color: #5a2d0c; background: linear-gradient(145deg, #f8f4ef 0%, #f5e6d3 55%, color-mix(in srgb, #e9c99f 35%, white) 100%); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #a87b51 28%, white); box-shadow: 0 20px 45px rgba(90, 45, 12, 0.12); } .ds-card-badge { display: inline-flex; padding: 0.45rem 0.85rem; border-radius: 999px; background: color-mix(in srgb, #c68642 18%, white); font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.9rem; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0.9rem 0 1.2rem; font-size: 1.8rem; line-height: 1.1; } .ds-card-tiles { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(160px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; } .ds-card-tile { padding: 1rem 1.1rem; border-radius: 16px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.72); border: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, #a87b51 18%, white); } .ds-card-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 0.35rem; font-size: 0.85rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: color-mix(in srgb, #5a2d0c 70%, white); }

narrative.overview:
The site should feel like being served across Felipe's own table: warm wood-and-cacao browns, flour-dusted creams, and nothing between the customer and the maker. Every surface is a shade of something you'd find in the kitchen (cacao, caramel, toffee, parchment, biscuit), so the whole storefront reads as one warm material rather than a white page with brown accents.

It is soft and inviting rather than formal: generously rounded containers, gently lifted cards with brown-tinted shadows, pill-shaped badges, and buttons that rise a couple of pixels on hover. Density is comfortable, with roomy padding and short line lengths, because people ordering for a celebration or a gift should never feel rushed or crowded.

It must never feel cold or corporate (no greys, blues or stark white SaaS chrome), never childish or cartoonish (no candy colours or bubbly illustration), and never like a generic bakery template. Personality comes from the maker's voice, real product photography and the warm palette, not from decoration.
keyCharacteristics: One warm brown family carries text, accents and surfaces; white appears only as a lifted card or button face.
Soft, generously rounded forms (8px fields up to 24px hero cards; pills for badges).
Brown-tinted ambient shadows, never neutral grey.
A single humanist sans (Tahoma) for everything; hierarchy comes from size and weight.
Gentle motion: 0.2–0.3s ease transitions, 2px hover lifts, underline-grow nav links.

rules.name: The Kitchen Palette Rule
rules.body: Every colour must be nameable as a baking material. If a new colour can't be (a grey, a blue, a neon), it doesn't belong.

rules.name: The No-Black Rule
rules.body: Text is Roasted Cacao (#5a2d0c), not #000 or neutral grey.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: A single typeface. Don't introduce a display serif or script to "add personality"; personality is the maker's words.

rules.name: The Warm Shadow Rule
rules.body: New shadows are tinted with Roasted Cacao (rgba(90, 45, 12, …)), not neutral black.

dos: Do set text in Roasted Cacao (#5a2d0c) and build surfaces from Flour Cream, Parchment and Biscuit.
Do keep forms soft: 8px fields, 14px buttons, 16–24px containers, pill badges.
Do tint shadows and borders with the brand browns (rgba(90, 45, 12, …), Toffee mixes).
Do keep a single primary action per view and use the Copper Crust gradient only for checkout.
Do show locked values (fixed City/Country) as read-only Locked Field inputs, not hidden or plain text.
donts: Don't use cold or corporate styling: greys, blues, stark white SaaS chrome or neutral-black shadows.
Don't go childish or cartoonish: no candy colours, bubbly illustrations or novelty fonts.
Don't make it look like a generic bakery template; let the maker's story, real photos and voice carry identity.
Don't introduce a second typeface or decorative script.
Don't use colour outside the kitchen palette except Error Red and Success Green for status text.
